title: Understanding Bias and Variance
text: When the training error increases but the validation error decreases, it suggests a change in the model's bias and variance. Consider how reducing the number of features might affect these two components.

title: Effect of Reducing Features
text: Reducing the number of features in a model can lead to an increase in bias because the model becomes simpler and may not capture all the complexities of the data. However, it can also reduce variance, as the model is less likely to overfit the training data.

title: Training vs. Validation Error
text: If the training error increases, it indicates that the model is not fitting the training data as well as before. However, if the validation error decreases, it suggests that the model is generalizing better to unseen data.
